name: MTE Flow
description: Start and watch MTE Flow runs on stock Orca: install MTE in a workspace, pin the worker agent, launch the planner and follow runs and workers.

statusBarItems.tooltip: MTE Flow: active workers. Click to open the panel.

settings.title: Planner agent
settings.description: Agent that runs the MTE planner in a terminal.

settings.title: Planner model
settings.description: Prefilled in the start-run form and passed to the planner launch. Leave empty for the agent's own default.

settings.title: Worker agent
settings.description: Agent pinned for the workers the planner dispatches.

settings.title: Worker model
settings.description: Pinned with `mte pin set`. Leave empty to skip the pin.

settings.title: Worker effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort for the pinned worker. Ignored for opencode.

settings.title: mte binary
settings.description: Command or absolute path of the MTE CLI. Install it with `npm i -g https://github.com/MTEKode/mte-flow-plugin/releases/download/mte-v0.3.0/mtekode-mte-0.3.0.tgz`; from a checkout of https://github.com/MTEKode/mte-flow-plugin use `cd packages/mte && npm link`.
